parts.name: DAC
parts.role: The CPU's 6-bit ladder (R74 to R90) as its Thevenin source: a twelfth of a volt a semitone, the A key 2.75 V

parts.name: RDAC
parts.role: The ladder's 100 kOhm; with C35 it sets the slide's 22 ms

parts.name: IC11b
parts.role: IC11b, a follower: the CV, 1 V an octave

parts.name: S8
parts.role: IC12's switch 8-9: puts C35 on the ladder while a slide plays, so the pitch glides

parts.name: S10
parts.role: IC12's switch 10-11: holds C35 at IC11b's output otherwise, so a slide starts from the pitch that sounds

parts.name: SLIDE
parts.role: The CPU's slide line (through Q29, Q30): high while a slide plays, closing S8

parts.name: /SLIDE
parts.role: The slide line's inverse: high otherwise, closing S10

parts.name: TM4
parts.role: TM4, the TUNE trimmer: its share of the reference current sets A at 110 Hz

parts.name: R102
parts.role: TM4's wiper into the reference node

parts.name: R103
parts.role: The reference current from 12 V into Q26's left half

parts.name: IC11a
parts.role: IC11a: holds Q26's left collector at 5.333 V by driving the pair's shared emitters

parts.name: Q26A
parts.role: Q26's left half: sinks the reference current, so the pair's emitters follow the temperature

parts.name: Q26B
parts.role: Q26's right half: the exponential current that empties C33, the pitch

parts.name: R100
parts.role: The posistor, 560 Ohm at 25 C: the scale's temperature compensation

parts.name: R106
parts.role: The CV into Q26's right base

parts.name: TM5
parts.role: TM5, the WIDTH trimmer: the volts an octave

parts.name: Q25
parts.role: The reset's NPN half: with Q27 a thyristor that fires near 5.5 V

parts.name: Q27
parts.role: The reset's PNP half: lifts C33 back up to 12 V

parts.name: D25
parts.role: Q27 into Q24's node: the thyristor's feedback

parts.name: Q24
parts.role: A diode: sets the reset's threshold above 5.333 V

parts.name: J28
parts.role: Q28, a source follower: the saw, without loading C33

parts.name: C33
parts.role: The saw's capacitor: Q26B empties it, the thyristor fills it again

parts.name: R105
parts.role: The follower's load: the saw, 5.6 to 11 V

parts.name: C10
parts.role: The saw's edge into Q8's base, for a sharp square

parts.name: C11
parts.role: Holds Q8's emitter at the saw's mean: the square's duty

parts.name: R36
parts.role: Q8's load to 5.333 V: the square

parts.name: WAVEFORM
parts.role: The WAVEFORM switch: the saw (set here) or the square into the filter

parts.name: C17
parts.role: The waveform into Q12's left base

parts.name: R95
parts.role: The filter's own rail from 12 V

parts.name: Q22L
parts.role: The ladder's top, left: its emitter the ladder's left top

parts.name: R115
parts.role: Q22's bases from the filter's rail

parts.name: Q16
parts.role: The ladder's left side, the third diode

parts.name: Q14
parts.role: The ladder's left side, the second diode

parts.name: Q13
parts.role: The ladder's left side, the first diode

parts.name: Q23
parts.role: The ladder's right side, the third diode

parts.name: Q17
parts.role: The ladder's right side, the second diode

parts.name: Q15
parts.role: The ladder's right side, the first diode

parts.name: Q12L
parts.role: The ladder's left input: Q11's current, split by the waveform

parts.name: Q12R
parts.role: The ladder's right input: the resonance comes back here

parts.name: C18
parts.role: The ladder's bottom rung: 0.018 uF, half the others

parts.name: R70
parts.role: Q12's left base to its bias

parts.name: R98
parts.role: Q12's right base to its bias

parts.name: R97
parts.role: The resonance into Q12's right base

parts.name: C27
parts.role: The ladder's right top into Q21's left base

parts.name: C25
parts.role: The ladder's left top into Q21's right base

parts.name: Q21R
parts.role: The read-out pair's right half: its collector is the filter's output

parts.name: R111
parts.role: Q21's left load (22 k: the service notes misprint 2.2 k)

parts.name: Q19
parts.role: A follower: TP6, the filter's output

parts.name: Q20
parts.role: The read-out pair's tail, about 0.5 mA

parts.name: R113
parts.role: Q21's left base to its bias

parts.name: R114
parts.role: Q21's right base to its bias

parts.name: R109
parts.role: Q20's base to ground: 5.333 V in three

parts.name: C14
parts.role: The output to RESONANCE and the VCA

parts.name: RESONANCE
parts.role: The RESONANCE knob's first gang: how much of the output goes back

parts.name: C15
parts.role: The resonance's way back, from the wiper

parts.name: Q18
parts.role: A follower: the resonance back into the ladder

parts.name: Q11
parts.role: Q11 sinks the ladder's current: the cutoff

parts.name: CUTOFF
parts.role: The CUTOFF knob: scales the current

parts.name: TM3
parts.role: TM3, the trimmer that sets the filter's scale

parts.name: R47
parts.role: CUTOFF's end into the common node

parts.name: Q10
parts.role: Q10, a follower: sets Q11's base above its own, exponentially

parts.name: R71
parts.role: Q10's base to the common node

parts.name: Q9
parts.role: Q9 holds the converter's common node near 3.3 V

parts.name: R64
parts.role: Q9's base to ground: half of 5.333 V

parts.name: Q38
parts.role: Q38, the one-shot: charges C62 at each new note

parts.name: C54
parts.role: The gate's edge: kicks Q38 on for a moment

parts.name: Q40
parts.role: The buffer's second follower: its emitter is the envelope

parts.name: J39
parts.role: Q39, a current sink under the buffer

parts.name: R138
parts.role: C62 runs down through R138 to the DECAY line

parts.name: DECAY
parts.role: The DECAY knob, 1 M, wired as a variable resistor

parts.name: S12B
parts.role: IC12B: shorts DECAY on an accent, the short 200 ms decay

parts.name: R117
parts.role: The diode string's current from 5.333 V

parts.name: S12A
parts.role: IC12A: passes the envelope to ACCENT on an accent

parts.name: ACCENT
parts.role: The ACCENT knob: its wiper sweeps the filter (D24) and lifts the VCA (R119)

parts.name: ACC
parts.role: The CPU's accent line (IC13's latch through Q35): 12 V on an accented step

parts.name: ENV MOD
parts.role: The ENV MOD knob: how much of the envelope moves the cutoff

parts.name: R61
parts.role: ENV MOD's end into the common node

parts.name: R63
parts.role: ENV MOD's wiper into Q10's base

parts.name: D24
parts.role: The ACCENT wiper into C13: only rises pass

parts.name: RES. 2
parts.role: The RESONANCE knob's second gang: more resonance, a slower accent sweep

parts.name: C13
parts.role: The accent sweep's capacitor: charges note by note on accents

parts.name: R72
parts.role: The accent sweep into Q10's base

parts.name: Q32
parts.role: Q32 empties C42 at each new note

parts.name: R123
parts.role: Refills C42: 1.5 M, the volume's own slow decay

parts.name: Q31
parts.role: Q31 sets the VCA's control current, pin 1

parts.name: R131
parts.role: Q31's emitter resistor: the control current

parts.name: R119
parts.role: The accent's wiper toward the VCA

parts.name: D27
parts.role: D27: the accent's share of the VCA's control current

parts.name: C21
parts.role: The filter's output into the VCA

parts.name: C22
parts.role: The RESONANCE wiper into the VCA

parts.name: Q5B
parts.role: The left Wilson mirror's output, X

parts.name: Q5A
parts.role: The right Wilson mirror's output, into pin 6

parts.name: Q2B
parts.role: The pair's right half: pin 3, the audio

parts.name: Q1B
parts.role: The mirror's output: the pair's tail current

parts.name: Q7B
parts.role: The NPN Wilson mirror's output: takes X's current out of pin 6

parts.name: R20
parts.role: Pin 4's current into the buffer's mirror

parts.name: C38
parts.role: The voice out to the mixer
